description.public:
Weapon Kit · Engineer invention. Counts as a weapon for swapping and stowing. Toolbelt options cost 2 Actions and 1 Toolbelt scrap.

Med Blaster (basic) — 1 Action. Reach 2. Target gains INT temp HP, 1 round. If they are Bloodied they regain HP instead.

Toolbelt (2 Actions, 1 scrap):

  • Vital Burst. Cone 2, Restore 2×INT HP.
  • Cleansing Mist. Burst 2, Restore 1d4 HP. Targets heal 1 negative condition.
  • Stim Pack. Reach 2. Ally gains +2 speed and +1 Max Actions on their next turn. They are Dazed for 1 turn at the end of the round.

High Levels: +2 bonus every 5 levels (Med Blaster, Vital Burst, Cleansing Mist).

[A] Med Blaster grants INT temp HP (+2 per 5 levels).

[A] Each Toolbelt option is its own "Med Kit: …" feature granted with the kit; using one spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[M] If the target is Bloodied it regains that much HP instead — apply it as healing. The temp HP lasts 1 round.
